u0: The agent has not yet carried the matching door key and has not picked up the target box. It must hold the key on at least two separate steps and pick up the designated box in the other room. The locked door still separates the agent from the box.
u1: The target box has been picked up, but the agent never carried the matching door key beforehand. The key requirement of holding the key on two distinct steps is completely unmet. Because picking up the box ends the episode, this situation represents an incomplete attempt that cannot satisfy the key requirement.
u2: The agent has held the matching door key on exactly one step and has not yet picked up the target box. It still needs to hold the key on at least one more distinct step and then pick up the designated box. Picking up the box after only one key-holding step would end the episode without completing the key requirement.
u3: The target box has been picked up after the agent carried the matching key on exactly one step. The box objective is met, but the key requirement remains one distinct hold short of the required two. Because box pickup ends the episode, this situation reflects an incomplete attempt in which the box was taken too soon.
u4: The agent has held the matching key on at least two distinct steps, so the key requirement is fully satisfied, and the target box has not yet been picked up. The only remaining objective is to pick up the designated box in the other room. Dropping or continuing to hold the key no longer affects the completed key requirement.
u5: The agent has held the matching door key on at least two distinct steps and has picked up the designated target box. Both requirements are satisfied, so the task is complete.
